newsitem.title: INDIA: Yield on Indian 91-day t-bill falls to 6.77 pct.
newsitem.headline: Yield on Indian 91-day t-bill falls to 6.77 pct.

text.p: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) said on Thursday it set a cut-off rate of 98.34 rupees at its weekly auction of 91-day treasury bills against last week's cut-off of 98.32 rupees.
Dealers said the yield fell to 6.77 percent from 6.85 percent last week.
The RBI said it received 24 competitive bids for 6.14 billion rupees of which it accepted 17 for 2.65 billion rupees.
It also received two non-competitive bids for 1.5 billion rupees. It allotted bills for 1.35 billion rupees to the two non-competitive bidders.
The weighted average cut-off was 98.41 rupees.
